# dsh-composer-balance

A minimal balance chip for DeepSeek Harness: one line in the composer dock showing the account
balan

ce and what the current session has cost, in the host's own visual
language.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Clicking the chip opens a small card (264px, the same box the host's context
card uses):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## What it does

- **Balance** — read from DeepSeek's `/user/balance` on the host, cached for
`refreshIntervalMs`; th

e browser never holds the API key.
- **Current session spend** — priced per settlement: the plugin r

egisters its
own session projection (`composerBalanceCost`) that folds each provider usage
sample an

d charges it at the tariff in force **at that turn's own timestamp**
(peak 09–12 / 14–18 CST weekday

s costs double). A session that spans peak and
off-peak therefore adds up correctly instead of being

priced at whatever
tariff happens to be live when the chip renders. Offline replay of a real
sessio

n matched the account's own daily figure within a few percent.
- **One card** — balance, session, la

st update, refresh and settings. Nothing
else competes for attention.
- **Native look and feel** — t

he chip uses the same geometry as the context
meter beside it; the card uses `--dsw-specific-menu`,

`--dsw-elevation-prominent`,
`--dsw-radius-lg` and a 12px/20px rhythm. Click to open, `Esc` or an ou

tside
click to close.
- **Local settings** — warning / critical thresholds (they only colour the ¥
i
con) and the auto-refresh interval, stored in `localStorage`.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Then restart the harness (`sudo systemctl restart dsh-web` for a systemd
deployment) and reload the

restart the harness (`sudo systemctl restart dsh-web` for a systemd
deployment) and reload the page.

If you also run another balance chip in the composer, disable one of them —
each entry renders its o

lso run another balance chip in the composer, disable one of them —
each entry renders its own chip.
## How the session figure is produced
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- **按轮计价** is the primary figure: every provider usage sample is priced at its
own timestamp (peak/o

ff-peak aware), summed over the session. It is the number
the provider would bill for that session's

tokens.
- **余额变动** is the accumulated drop of the account balance since the chip
started watching.

It is the ground truth for "what left my account", but it
also includes any other activity on the sa

me key.
- The displayed value never walks backwards: it is the max of the two and of the
highest val
ue already shown for that session.
## Configuration
Write overrides into your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`defaultPrice` / `modelPrices` ship with placeholder numbers — replace them with
the provider's curr

ent list price so the session estimate is meaningful. Tokens
are always shown; a missing price only
greys out the amount.
## Notes

- The route is read-only and never returns the API key; every request must pass
the host's connectio

n admission (identity plus Origin/Host fence), and the
route refuses the request when that service i

s unavailable.
- The entry renders last in the composer dock (`order: 1`), so it lines up after
the

host's token/context meter.
- The bundle is written against the host's public client seats: the
`con

versation.composer.dock` slot, the `tokenUsage` projection, and locale
dictionaries.
